spec_raw: In classic theme when size is lg the border is not visible for input

spec_refined.title: Text input: lg size loses its border in classic theme
spec_refined.description: When a modus-wc-text-input has size='lg' under the classic theme, the input border is not rendered. sm and md sizes show the border correctly; lg must match.
acceptance_criteria: size='lg' text input renders a visible border in classic light theme
size='lg' text input renders a visible border in classic dark theme
Border styling for sm and md sizes is unchanged
Modern and connect themes are unchanged; existing tests pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Check the size-conditional classes in modus-wc-text-input.tailwind.ts and classic theme overrides.
